topics.label: Welcome and Lecture Framing
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture by outlining its learning objectives and framing cancer development as an evolutionary process shaped by cellular origins and microenvironments.

topics.label: Genetic and Epigenetic Mechanisms of Clonal Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how cell-intrinsic driver mutations and epigenetic alterations confer competitive advantages and drive Darwinian clonal evolution in pre-malignant tissues.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and the Cancer Stem Cell Model
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how normal tissue hierarchies and specific cells of origin influence tumor initiation, providing experimental evidence for cancer stem cell models in leukemia and colorectal cancer.

topics.label: Microenvironmental Influence, Inflammation, and Tumor Coevolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate how inflammatory, stromal, and wider environmental factors promote and sustain tumor progression alongside profiling methods and a synthesis of cancer coevolution.

topics.label: Closing Remarks and Next Lecture
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the topic of cancer therapy for the following session.
